lang.label: Language
app.title: HR Breath Pacer
line.needSource: Your smartwatch or chest strap must share heart rate over Bluetooth (the standard Heart Rate profile).
line.nocontact: The smartwatch can’t feel your pulse. Wear it a little tighter, sensor against your skin.
line.settling: One moment while your heart rate settles, so the music starts at the right tempo.
msg.noHR: No heart rate yet: the music plays at {bpm} BPM until the first reading arrives.
msg.timerEnded: The sleep timer ended the session.
ble.insecure: This page is open over plain http ({host}). Bluetooth only works over https or on localhost: open the address that starts with https://.
ble.brave: Brave turns Bluetooth off by default. Go to brave://flags, enable “Web Bluetooth API” and restart the browser, or open this page in Chrome.
ble.unsupported: This browser doesn’t support Bluetooth on web pages. Use Chrome or Edge (Windows, macOS, Android). iPhones don’t support it.
gap.caption: Heart rate and music tempo
gap.slower: music is {n} BPM slower than your heart
gap.inStep: music in step with your heart
trend.aria: Chart: heart rate in pink, music tempo in blue
trend.noRecent: No readings in the last 5 minutes
trend.waiting: Waiting for the first heart rate reading
controls.simAlt: No smartwatch? Simulate a heart rate
light.aria: Breath light: grows as you breathe in, shrinks as you breathe out
settings.title: Settings
breath.mode.fixed: Fixed seconds, whatever your heart rate
breath.mode.sync: Music beats, faster at a higher heart rate
breath.pattern.prog: Lengthen the exhale from 4 : 6 to 4 : 8 over 15 minutes
breath.inUnderHint: Swells through the inhale and fades just before the exhale.
breath.outUnderHint: Plays beneath the exhale, starting just after its cue.
breath.playInTex: Play the sound under the inhale
breath.playOutTex: Play the sound under the exhale
watch.title: Smartwatch
watch.state.nocontact: Connected, but the sensor isn’t touching your skin.
watch.stale: No new readings for more than 10 seconds.
sim.title: Simulation
sim.hint: For trying the app without a smartwatch. While it’s on, smartwatch readings are ignored.
sim.asleep: Simulate calming down: 80 to 55 BPM in 3 minutes
follow.title: How the music follows your heart
follow.hint: The music tempo is your heart rate minus the gap you set, but never slower than the minimum.
follow.offset: Music slower than your heart by
bowls.title: Background bowls
bowls.hint: Random strikes in the music’s key. Never right after a breath cue.
timer.title: Sleep timer
timer.hint: The music fades out gently over the last minute, then the session ends.
screen.title: Screen
screen.noWakeLock: This browser can’t keep the screen awake. Lengthen the screen timeout in your system settings so the smartwatch doesn’t disconnect.
screen.wakeLock: During a session the screen stays on.
screen.dim: Dim the interface during a session
screen.dimHint: After 10 seconds without a touch, everything but the breath light fades out. Touch the screen to bring it back.
quality.title: Sound quality
quality.hint: If the sound crackles or stutters, choose a lighter setting. It takes less work from your device, and the music hardly changes.
quality.label: Quality
quality.later: Takes effect when you start the next session.
defaults.title: Default settings
defaults.hint: Puts every setting in every tab back the way the app came, volumes included. Your smartwatch stays connected and the language stays as it is.
defaults.atDefaults: All settings are at their defaults
defaults.confirm: Reset all settings? This can’t be undone.
